package.name: easyfleet_easynav_collaboration_fastdds_deployment
package.description: Same two-robot scenario as easyfleet_easynav_collaboration_deployment / easyfleet_easynav_collaboration_zenoh_deployment (real EasyNav navigation on both robots, robot_1 also carrying a fake perception capability, robot_2 a fake manipulation one, same Gazebo world/map, same launch/config/rviz shape, robot_node.cpp written against easyfleet_core::Deployment's simpler API), but the multi-robot isolation strategy is the default RMW (FastDDS) with a separate ROS_DOMAIN_ID per robot and per the central island, bridged by eProsima DDS Router instead of rmw_zenoh + ACLs -- see fastdds.md at the workspace root for the full design discussion, the empirical findings behind every DDS Router config choice, and the comparison against the Zenoh-island sibling deployment. DDS Router is not an ament/colcon package and must be built once via scripts/build_dds_router.sh before this deployment's launch files (which invoke the resulting `ddsrouter` executable directly) will work.
